records.title: The Public Wisdom Compact
records.epistemic_type: chosen editorial policy with empirical support debt
records.scope: Emergentism editorial, research, and public-projection practice only
records.proposition: A public reasoning practice should preserve source ancestry, separate promotion and consequence states, expose authority and bearer ledgers, and remain correctable after publication.
clauses: Keep possibility wide; make commitment accountable.
Preserve ancestry; correction creates a successor rather than silently overwriting.
Capability, intelligence, popularity, product position, or consensus grants no authority.
Keep proposal, Judgment, authorization, execution, receipt, outcome, and revision distinct.
Count creation, destruction, and preservation separately by bearer and horizon; never hide them inside one unsupported scalar.
Publicity begins another feedback loop: reach is not truth, and correction, contestability, and Exit remain available.
records.compression: Keep possibility wide. Make commitment accountable. Nothing promotes itself. Reality retains the right to correct every map.

bearer_ledgers.consent: no product adoption is inferred from inclusion
bearer_ledgers.exit: source owner may reject the candidate application without losing its native record

bearer_ledgers.creation: a compact map of warrant, decision, policy, and publicity
bearer_ledgers.destruction: attention cost and risk of framework vocabulary crowding out native terms
bearer_ledgers.preservation: access to sources, rivals, kills, corrections, and genuine Exit
bearer_ledgers.consent: worldview adoption is never required to inspect or contribute
bearer_ledgers.exit: the map can be put down; citations and native distinctions remain

bearer_ledgers.creation: visible authorization, consequence, and correction boundaries
bearer_ledgers.destruction: possible delay where urgent action is justified
bearer_ledgers.consent: no proxy mandate or public consent is manufactured by the Compact
bearer_ledgers.exit: separately applicable rights, deletion duties, withdrawal, and challenge remain controlling

rivals: ordinary source criticism, audit trails, version control, decision journals, and scientific peer review may supply the same discipline with less vocabulary
a faster risk-proportionate process may outperform the full stack for reversible low-consequence work
kill_criteria: supersede or narrow the policy if it systematically blocks justified action, hides real authority, or makes correction harder
retract any clause that preserves harmful data against valid privacy, deletion, revocation, contract, or legal duties
do not promote to SUPPORTED unless admitted independent outcomes beat named simpler controls on error detection, correction, reversibility, or bearer protection
records.public_digest: A compact for turning ideas into accountable, revisable guidance without confusing visibility, consensus, capability, or receipts with truth or authority.
records.state_note: Locally authorized for the Emergentism v3 candidate; not lit, externally validated, product-adopted, or Supported.
